text:
Anya: Quick sync — owners needed for the v2 -> default + v1 deprecation canary next week. TL;DR: v2 becomes default for hosted routes, v1 served for a 30d grace window behind an explicit header. We need: canary plan + rollback playbook, routing changes, SDK migration helpers, CI lint to catch hardcoded /v1 paths. Who can own the canary and the playbook?

Jon: I can own the canary deploy for us-west. Will open a checklist PR today and add a rollback runbook. Need @Maria for routing changes (route table + traffic weights). :ok_hand:

Maria: I can take routing & fallback policy. Quick question: are we renaming endpoints (eg /v2/generate -> /generate) or keeping explicit namespaces? Need exact spec to update ingress.

Anya: Spec we agreed on in design sync: keep /v2/* as the explicit versioned paths for the next 30d while we flip the default host routing so new clients hit v2 without changing SDKs. For legacy behavior we add a header: `X-RI-Compat: v1`. SDKs should automatically set that header for pinned old versions. Also add a CI lint to warn/fail on absolute "/v1/" strings. Example header snippet for SDKs:

```python
# old SDK should send compat header to opt into v1 behavior
headers = {"X-RI-Compat": "v1"}
resp = session.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)
```

Sam: I'm working on the SDK migration helper. PR #4328 adds automatic compat header for older SDK versions and prints a deprecation warning at startup. I'll add a migration snippet and changelog entry. Can infra provide a canary token for limited-testing accounts? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC to us-west-2. Rollback window: 3h. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/12345

Lee: I'll own runtime fallback tests — need to ensure KV cache keys are compatible when routing back to v1 variants and exercise the compat shim. Question: what's our SLA for degraded (fallback) mode? Do we keep latency SLOs or relax them?

Anya: SLA guidance: keep availability at 99% for user-facing requests; latency can degrade but we should monitor 95th and alert early. Add a metric `v2_compat_fallback` and a dashboard tile.

Jon: Adding CI lint to checklist: simple grep in pre-commit and a failing job on main for any hardcoded "/v1/" paths. Will also tag infra for canary token in PR. PR link will go in the checklist once opened.

Maria: Thx — adding myself to review list. If anyone is blocked on infra creds, please @ops on the PR.

Sam: ETA for SDK canary release is 2026-04-05, GA target 2026-04-20. I'll coordinate release notes and migration guide.

Anya: Great. Owners captured: Jon (canary deploy + playbook), Maria (routing + fallback policy), Lee (runtime tests), Sam (SDK migration + release notes). I'll create a confluence checklist and link to the PRs. @deploy-bot please add a 24h reminder before canary start. :calendar:

Jon: Pinged infra for canary token. I'll post the checklist PR link when ready.

Maria: Putting a short checklist in the PR: ingress change, traffic weights, fallback policy, changelog entry, monitoring dashboards, rollback steps.

Sam: I'll include sample migration snippets in multiple languages and a small script to toggle the compat header for testing.

Anya: Awesome — thanks everyone. If you're blocked, drop a quick note here. Otherwise we'll reconvene async via the PRs. :pray:
